comments:
The work was written down at the occasion of a teaching of sKyo ston (ID:4052) to Chos kyi rgyal mtshan (ID:6458), who maybe was also the scribe. 
An addition mentions sNar thang as a place of copy, either of the original manuscript or of this instance.
Same images in 2_056_09, pp. 37-38.
